description: Patients who have at least one examination whose recorded ANA pattern is something other than S.

d.request: For patients in the Patient table who have at least one examination with a non-null ANA Pattern other than 'S', list each patient's ID, sex, and the unrounded average aCL IgM across all their examinations, ignoring missing aCL IgM values; group by patient ID and sex, sort by average descending with missing averages last, and show the top 10.
d.sql:
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e2
    WHERE e2.ID = p.ID
      AND e2.`ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL
      AND e2.`ANA Pattern` <> 'S'
)
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
ORDER BY avg_aCL_IgM DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

a.request: For patients with at least one examination record whose `ANA Pattern` is recorded and is something other than 'S', list each patient's ID, their sex (from the Patient table, only patients present there), and the average `aCL IgM` across all of their examinations (ignoring missing values, unrounded). Group by patient ID and sex, sort by that average from highest to lowest with missing averages last, and show the top 10.
a.sql:
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e2
    WHERE e2.ID = p.ID
      AND e2.`ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL
      AND e2.`ANA Pattern` <> 'S'
)
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
ORDER BY avg_aCL_IgM DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

c.request: Among patients whose examinations don't show an `ANA Pattern` of 'S', list each patient's ID, their sex (from the Patient table, only patients present there), and the average `aCL IgM` across all of their examinations (ignoring missing values, unrounded). Group by patient ID and sex, sort by that average from highest to lowest with missing averages last, and show the top 10. Patients who have at least one examination whose recorded ANA pattern is something other than S.
c.sql:
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN e.`ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND e.`ANA Pattern` <> 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY avg_aCL_IgM DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

b.request: For each patient in the Patient table who has at least one examination with a recorded ANA Pattern other than 'S', list the patient’s ID, sex, and the unrounded average of their non-null aCL IgM values across all examinations; group by ID and sex, sort by average descending with missing averages last, and return the top 10.
b.sql:
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN e.`ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND e.`ANA Pattern` <> 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY avg_aCL_IgM IS NULL, avg_aCL_IgM DESC
LIMIT 10;
